# TabRail

> Control the Chrome tabs you are already logged into, from any MCP client.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): overview, quick start, configuration
- [Install](docs/install.md): step-by-step for humans
- [AI install contract](docs/ai-install.md): instructions for agents installing TabRail
- [Security](SECURITY.md): threat model and controls
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): development and release

## Commands

- `npx -y tabrail setup` prints MCP client configuration
- `npx -y tabrail extension` extracts the Chrome extension and prints its folder
- `npx -y tabrail doctor` checks token, bridge, and extension state
- `npx -y tabrail mcp` runs the MCP server over stdio

## Notes for models

- Register the server as `chrome`
- Keep `MCP_BROWSER_ALLOW_LOCAL_PAIRING=1` for automatic pairing
- Ask the user to load the extension folder in `chrome://extensions`
- Never request cookies, tokens, or passwords in chat
- Call `browser_snapshot` before clicking or typing
